paragraphs.text: Pontotoc gave up just nine team points across two duals in its home wrestling opener Thursday. The Warriors beat Center Hill 75–6 and New Albany 76–3, according to the team’s scorecard.

Against New Albany, Pontotoc’s Aiden Stone pinned Caden Derryberry in 2 minutes, 24 seconds at 113 pounds. Cesar Lopez recorded a faster fall at 126, pinning Daniel Peters in 1:43. At 132, Evan Parker beat Chanapon Weaver by technical fall, 23–8, in four minutes.

South Pontotoc had three pins against French Camp at a separate meet in Oxford. Javion Anderson stopped Sterling Petty in 3:36 at 106 pounds. Bentlee Alward pinned Hunter Dodd in 1:09 at 126, and Caspian Call pinned Hayden Swindle in 1:07 at 132.
In the girls matches against Oxford, South Pontotoc’s Kennedi Crowley won by fall in 1:54 at 145 pounds. Keeleigh Crowley needed just 49 seconds to pin Oxford’s Nhari Jones at 185.
Pontotoc and New Albany meet again Tuesday, Dec. 1, this time in New Albany. The Warriors are due back home Thursday, Dec. 3, when South Pontotoc and South Panola visit.
